name: Seoul POPCON
blurb: Seoul's pop-culture convention at COEX, produced with Brazil's CCXP and spanning games, comics, webtoons, film, music and cosplay.
notes: The 2026 edition (Seoul POPCON 2026 by CCXP) already ran Aug 14-16, 2026 at COEX, confirmed by the homepage's own key-art banner text '14(Fri)-16(Sun) August, Coex' and matching WebSearch results — that is before today's window start (2026-10-05), so it is recorded as "last" instead of an edition. No 2027 dates are announced yet (homepage re-checked fresh 2026-10-05, unchanged): the show-info page is still titled '2026 Show Information' and the newest Notice post is an 8 Apr 2026 item about 2026 booth applications, with nothing posted since the August show. A WebSearch found Korean press (Inven Global) reporting the event will be rebranded 'CCXP Korea' starting in 2027, with 2026 described as a preparation period, but no 2027 date or month has actually been announced anywhere, so this is not recorded as an edition. Organizer is Exporum Inc. (CEO Danny Hyundae Shin, per site footer); 'by CCXP' in the branding reflects a partnership with Brazil's CCXP, not a separate organizer.
